# Internal binary names (JVMS §4.2.1) of the corpus's real JDK classes,
# one per line. Source of truth for corpus membership: generate.sh builds
# its `jimage extract --include` glob list from this file, and
# tests/jdk_corpus.rs discovers fixtures from it rather than hardcoding
# the list in Rust. Picked for variety, not exhaustiveness:
#   - java/lang/String        a large real class (171 methods, 5 interfaces)
#   - java/util/ArrayList     real InnerClasses (Itr, ListItr, ...), 4 interfaces
#   - java/util/List          an interface with a generic `extends`
#   - java/lang/constant/ConstantDesc  a real sealed interface (PermittedSubclasses)
#   - java/time/DayOfWeek     a real enum (ACC_ENUM)
#   - java/util/stream/Stream an interface with heavy generic signatures
java/lang/String
java/util/ArrayList
java/util/List
java/lang/constant/ConstantDesc
java/time/DayOfWeek
java/util/stream/Stream
